notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA list names a tower here, and it says only 'Tower Gone'. No build date, design, staffing or site description was found, so the story is short (92 words) and no events are recorded. Brief checked: county, coordinates and gone status match, so no correction. The name matches Pimushe Lake, but no source ties the tower to the lake or its shore. The How's Your River boat-ramp coordinates (47.5476, -94.5122) are a few kilometres from the FFLA point, so the ramp is not a stand-in for the site. The LakeHomes page spells the lake 'Pumishe' once and gives 1,365 acres; a search snippet from another site gave 1,230 acres, which was not fetched and is not used. Check that the Pimushe name is not an alias for another Beltrami County tower: the FFLA list also has Pinewood (Gone, 47.59987 -95.12383) and a relocated Pinewood tower at the Forestry Education Center (47.54055 -94.89598).
